==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Long'er:''' Hey, you're the Rover, right? I'm the boss of [[Maosan]] and [[Gousi]]. They told me you've saved them from some kind of mess.
:{{DIcon}} It's me.
::'''Long'er:''' I know you're some expert!
:{{DIcon}} You have interesting names.
::'''Long'er:''' Betcha! We've gone through a lot together. Names are the representations!
:'''Long'er:''' Thank you for saving them. They were crying lightning just like some naughty kids. Can't deal with them, right?
:'''Long'er:''' I should be nice to them. We live our lives, no more dirty jobs!
{{Dialogue End}}
